BiblicalUsage: Jeremiah cries, O Lord, thou hast seen my wrong — judge thou my cause. The word is oppression, the wrong done to a man by those stronger than him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God sees every wrong done to his people, and that is why Jeremiah could hand his cause over instead of taking revenge himself.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
